## Summary

- Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- Tested commit:
- Commands and results (including pass/fail/skip counts):
- Relevant UI/integration checks, or why they are unnecessary:
- Timeouts, unavailable fixtures, or remaining limitations:

Follow [validation policy](https://github.com/RoySalisbury/HVO.AgentControl/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION_POLICY.md). The short automatic `build` check supplements worker validation and independent review. For documentation/workflow-only changes, describe the relevant checks instead of claiming a full application test run.
